bannerNotice.body: A notable contrast: China's revision to introduce an expected credit loss model became effective for listed companies from 2018 and other enterprises from 2021 – several years ahead of Japan GAAP, which was only proposing an equivalent expected credit loss model in a February 2026 exposure draft.
bannerNotice.title: China Converged Faster

title: Recognition and Measurement of Financial Instruments
